Offer cannot be combined with other Citizens checking offers; eligibility at Citizens' sole discretion.

steps: Go to the official Citizens promo page https://www.citizensbank.com/promo/checking/26-q3-bau-red.aspx and confirm the $400 offer is still live.
Open a new Citizens personal checking account through the promo page (Quest Checking minimum opening balance can be any amount).
Within 60 days of the account open date, receive a single direct deposit of $1,000 or more into the new checking account.
Note your payout date from the key-dates table (e.g., September 2026 opens pay by January 31, 2027) and keep the account open through it.
To avoid the $25 monthly fee, set up $5,000+ in total deposits per statement period (your bonus-run deposit helps) or meet another waiver.
The $400 bonus is deposited automatically by the payout date — no claim form needed.
